body:
I have a long history with stuff-n-things. dxm being my fav with coke IV a close second.
I've spent the last week doing research on methylone and like substances. I had tried methylone once before(140mg insufflated) I was told it was mdma, felt like doing meth and lasted 6 hours. After doing my homework I came to the conclusion that it is probably safer than most of the shit I find on the street. I obtained 1 gram of methylone. I had decided the previous day that I was gonna shoot it with a starting dose of 100mg.
1:00pm Sat down with my works and product, started some relaxing breathing and calmed myself as much as possible. Prepared 100mg with 10 cc water, didn't seem to brake down as much as I was led to believe, added 10 cc more water, mixed and filtered  with a paste left in spoon and and 15 cc n syringe.  Hit myself with no problem and felt a  little stimulation. It was enough to try again 10 minutes later.  100 mg with 25 cc water and took my time mixing pulled back 25 cc, but still had a paste left over. this shot was better and I could feel the fiend in me coming out. I left the residue in the spoon for the next shot.  20 minutes latter I added 150 mg to the residue and 30cc water, mixed the shit out of it and pulled back 35 cc, did the load didn't think it was much better, and made a phone call. about 3 minutes after the shot while on the phone it hit me. it was like a GOOD coke  blast and all I could do was sit down and whisper to my buddy that its good to shoot. I was in heaven. Short rush(2-7 min) and then it felt like a normal IV meth high, but I didn't have the amp.  Come to find out a little heat and the methylone will dissolve pretty good.  I got up to 250 mg  at one dose, but it was before I decided to use heat to completely break down. Due to this my actual doses were for the most smaller than thought. 1gram,  12 hours, and 8 shots.
My conclusion is that methylone is AWESOME and FUCKING ADDICTIVE! Today was the first time in nine years I did more than three shots in 24 hours.  It's been 2 hours since I did the last of it and I can't wait till I get more.  This drug may truly kill me.
